top_line: Sheffield Teaching is £15.2m adverse to plan at month 3 with a £19m risk to breakeven and its 'highest ever' efficiency ask, NHSE says it is 'not sufficiently assured' by the board's own planning self-assessment after the trust fell from 26th to 86th in the oversight framework and into segment 3, an independent well-led review has been procured, and a coroner found a baby would have survived had the mother been admitted after maternity triage.
